responsibility: Declares the generic tree conversion API implemented in convert.cc. It exposes the main conversion entry points for integer, pointer, real, fixed-point, complex, and vector conversions, plus no-fold inline wrappers and the helper for preserving location wrappers, making this the shared interface used by front ends and middle-end tree-building code when constructing typed conversion expressions.
same_name_distinction: Declares the generic conversion API and lightweight inline no-fold wrappers used by front ends and middle-end code; unlike gcc/convert.cc, it does not contain the conversion semantics, folding logic, diagnostics, or selftests.
